about.description: Backed issues tokenized versions of public-market assets such as stocks and ETFs designed for use across crypto venues, with each product intended to be fully backed by the corresponding underlying security held through traditional custody rails. The Backed ecosystem is built around transparency and composability, with a proof-of-reserves framework that allows market participants to verify backing for supported products.
about.registryInfo: Swiss company (Aktiengesellschaft) based in Zug, operating a tokenization platform for fully backed ERC-20 securities, parent of Backed Assets (JE) Limited, the issuer of Backed tracker certificates.
